goal: Implement the native-authority and Managed routing contract in docs/specs/2026-09-04-001-claude-native-elicitation-authority.spec.md: replace Claude permission-Hook authorization with one post-preparation server-initiated MCP elicitation for all privileged operations; bind acceptance to the exact live connection, Tool identity, operation, task, Intent revision/hash, and digest; preserve zero-write fail-closed cancellation, shutdown, replay, drift, and unsupported-Host behavior; keep plan-only artifacts non-authoritative; prohibit Direct, Pi, cross-worktree, or unmanaged fallback guidance after Managed authority failure; preserve Kernel, Pi, persisted-state, and Tool-input compatibility; and bind generated package bytes and Host support claims to deterministic tests plus updated real-Host evidence.

acceptance.assertion: All four privileged Claude operations use the Spec's post-preparation server-initiated elicitation sequence. Only an exact accept response to the outstanding nested request on the same trusted connection may proceed to binding revalidation and one-shot capability issuance; production runtime options and Tool metadata expose no direct-decision or preapproval seam, and deterministic tests inject the asynchronous NativeConfirmationPort boundary. Permission mode, Tool arguments, Hook events, chat text, malformed/unknown/duplicate/replayed responses, decline, cancel, outer cancellation, disconnect, shutdown, unsupported protocol, and workspace drift cannot mint authority. Stdio transport writes settle on drain, error, or close; output disconnect or failure rejects pending elicitations and settles outer Tool calls. A malformed envelope carrying the exact pending nested request ID rejects that waiter with correlation_missing instead of hanging. Breaking revision restoration and postcommit Projection reconciliation remain intact.

Canonical Brainstorm, Planner, Loop, and BASELINE contracts use current-Host native authority language; explicit plan-only requests stop after candidate Spec/TaskIntent validation without invoking Enrollment; execution-bearing requests invoke the native gate directly; and every Managed authority failure reports one stable reason and one current-Host recovery action without suggesting Direct Path, Pi fallback, cross-worktree Enrollment, CLI authority mutation, or implementation without a Workspace Claim. Workspace binding drift detected before or after native confirmation reports workspace_changed with one fresh-current-Host-gate recovery action.

The self-contained Claude plugin negotiates an MCP revision that supports elicitation, processes nested JSON-RPC responses while an outer Tool call is pending, removes ElicitationResult authority wiring, preserves public Tool names and input schemas, rejects unsupported Host/protocol versions before mutation, and regenerates deterministic package bytes. Current support docs and a new sanitized conformance report bind the declared minimum Claude version to real interactive plan-only, preapproval, accept, decline, cancel, disconnect, and privileged-operation evidence without presenting HITL observations as QA or Kernel authority.
